concerns.text: FR-001 requires downloading and preprocessing **at least three** public scRNA‑seq datasets, but Task T003 only enforces the presence of *any* dataset (≥1) and allows the pipeline to continue with a single dataset, thereby weakening the functional requirement.

FR-003 mandates computation of the **Local Continuity (LCA)** metric, yet Task T004 computes both global linearity and local continuity using the **Trustworthiness** metric, omitting the required LCA calculation and thus violating the specification.

FR-006 specifies a mixed‑effects model (`fidelity ~ method + (1|dataset)`). Task T008 conditionally falls back to a Fixed‑Effects ANOVA when fewer than two datasets are available, which weakens the required statistical analysis without an explicit spec amendment.

SC-002 expects measurement of the interaction p‑value after FDR correction. In the case‑study mode (single dataset) the mixed‑effects model is not fitted, so no interaction term exists, making this success criterion untestable and effectively weakened.

Constitution Principle II (Verified Accuracy) is breached: the tasks proceed even when the required GEO datasets lack verified raw‑count sources, contradicting the constitution’s mandate to ensure verified external data before analysis.

Constitution Principle VI (Geometric Characterization Protocol) requires diagnostics be computed directly from the **raw high‑dimensional space**. Task T004 computes geometric metrics on a **sampled** subset, violating the protocol and weakening the geometric characterization.
